description: AICTIONBOT™ stakeholder map by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T30 (stakeholder mapping). Takes the people involved (name or role, influence 1 to 5, interest 1 to 5, attitude from opponent to champion, whom each person can bring along, their concern and who on the user's side talks to them) and returns the four fields (manage closely, keep satisfied, keep informed, monitor) with a cadence for each, a numbered conversation plan (win influential advocates first, then neutrals through a bridge person, then critics prepared, then the interested), influential critics without a bridge, people without a contact on the user's side and missing values. Recommends roles instead of names when sharing. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

stakeholders.description: Rows: name or role, group, influence (1 to 5), interest (1 to 5), attitude (-2 to 2 or opponent, critical, neutral, supportive, champion), brings_along (names), owner (our contact), concern.
